title: Package Manifest
description: Normative JSON Schema for S1 – Package Manifest Schema of the KAPRI Specification Suite.
$comment: This schema references the common data types defined by SC1 – Common Data Types.

schema_version.description: SC1 §4.3 Schema Version. Version of the referenced Package Manifest schema.

package_id.description: SC1 §4.5 URI. Unique identifier of the Knowledge Asset Package.

knowledge_asset_id.description: SC1 §4.5 URI. Unique identifier of the Knowledge Asset.

knowledge_asset_version_id.description: SC1 §4.2 Version Identifier. Unique identifier of the published Knowledge Asset version.

knowledge_asset_version_label.description: Human-readable label of the published Knowledge Asset version.

title.description: Human-readable title of the published Knowledge Asset version.

publication_scope.description: Publication scope of the Knowledge Asset Package.

published_at.description: SC1 §4.16 Timestamp. Publication timestamp of the Package.

document_reference.description: SC1 §4.9 Document Reference. Reference to a Package document including integrity information.

document_id.description: SC1 §4.5 URI. Unique identifier of the referenced Package document.

hash_algorithm.description: SC1 §4.11 Hash Algorithm. Cryptographic algorithm used to calculate the Hash.

hash.description: SC1 §4.10 Hash. Cryptographic digest of the referenced Package document.

organization.description: SC1 §4.4 Organization. Organization responsible for publication.

organization_id.description: SC1 §4.5 URI. Unique identifier of the organization.

valid_from.description: SC1 §4.16 Timestamp. Beginning of the validity period.

valid_until.description: SC1 §4.16 Timestamp. End of the validity period.

signature.description: SC1 §4.12 Signature. Digital signature protecting the Package Manifest.

certificate_chain.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference[]. Ordered leaf-to-root, self-contained (each entry embeds its own certificate).

certificate_id.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference. Stable identifier of the certificate.

subject.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference. Subject Distinguished Name in RFC 4514 string form.

issuer.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference. Issuer Distinguished Name in RFC 4514 string form.

serial_number.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference. Certificate serial number, decimal string.

certificate.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference. DER-encoded X.509 certificate using Base64 according to RFC 4648 Section 4 with padding.

signature_value.description: Digital signature over the canonical representation of the Package Manifest.
